summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HDOS v2 Circle Trust Order system. All backend APIs (17 tests) and frontend UI components are working correctly. Trust Order tab with Levels, Policies, and Assignments sub-tabs fully functional.
seed_data_creation: Test assignments created and cleaned up during testing

Frontend has Trust Order tab in Founder Control Center with 3 sub-tabs: Levels (read-only, shows 7 canonical levels), Policies (CRUD per level), Assignments (CRUD for subjects). All data-testid attributes are properly implemented.
